parameters.query: SELECT sender, kind FROM allowed_senders WHERE enabled = true

INSERT INTO emails (gmail_message_id, kind, sender, subject, snippet, body_html, received_at, status) SELECT r.gmail_message_id, r.kind, r.sender, r.subject, r.snippet, r.body_html, r.received_at, 'unprocessed' FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS r(gmail_message_id text, kind text, sender text, subject text, snippet text, body_html text, received_at timestamptz) ON CONFLICT (gmail_message_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING 1
UPDATE search_run_steps SET status = 'done', found = $1, "new" = $2, message = $3 WHERE run_id = $4 AND source = 'email'
